purpose: Test whether earlier time release can add entries to the four exact current sleeve streams without changing their entry definitions, target R, protective R, direction, ATR or filter formulas.
A_CORE_rule: The shorter horizon applies to the parent one-position state before the unchanged P7/WATCH filtering, matching the original processing order.
other_sleeves_rule: The shorter horizon applies to the unchanged final structural event stream before sleeve one-position admission.
2026: Diagnostic only and not used to select or modify a variant.
selection: Each variant is evaluated only against its own original parent sleeve. No cross-variant optimization or partial time search is allowed.
